features: Perfect Footstool: The cover of the footrest is made of linen material and is filled with high-density thick sponge, is a great comfort for your tired feet.It helps keep the foot elevated, reduces pressure on the ankle and prevents swelling.
Multifunctional Ottoman: Elegant and chic design with class decorative appearance match for many place. It can also work as a pet step stool, small stool for sitting, coffee table chest, etc.
Anti-Slip & Sturdy: These stool legs come with specific spacers and felt pads to prevent scratches on floor and keep it from sliding. The maximum load capacity is 440 pounds.
Product Dimension: This ottoman foot rest measures 15.4''L x 11''W x 8.3''H, featuring small size and light weight, you can place it near a sofa, under a chair or even under a table.

Easy to Assemble: The installation of the small stool is very easy, just need to screw the 4 legs of the stool. Note: The 4 legs are in the zipper pocket at the bottom. You can storage keys or kid's small toys in this hidden space.
